_about: REF-012 door contract, World -> Gameplay (DEC-096 playtest 1: doors). One row per door or opening. Plan frame = REFERENCES_INDEX 1.2 (feet, origin Retail NW outer corner, +x east, +y south); Unity X = x*0.3048, Z = -y*0.3048 (graybox_layout.json). Sources: TI A310 door schedule + hardware sets (read 2026-10-30, only closer/lock/lever-vs-push-bar recorded; no access-control hardware, DEC-051), A011, ROOM_FIXTURES.json, DECs. Fields: id; object = scene object 'Door_<id>'; type = swing | storefrontPair | opening (no leaf) | foldingGrille; ti_door = A310 number (2022 room numbers, REFERENCES_INDEX 6); rooms.A/B = the two sides; graybox_wall + graybox_opening = current graybox wall id and opening [from,to] along it (read-only here); target_opening = where A011 puts it when the graybox is still wrong (ART fixes; hinge and anchors use the target); pos_ft = opening centre on the wall line; hinge_jamb = compass jamb (N/S/E/W). DEC-110 W5 as amended by DEC-115 (1): doors hinge LEFT unless CCTV or the A011/TI vector drawing shows otherwise; 'left' = the hinge is on your left when you stand on the side the door swings AWAY from (the push side) and face the door; swing = in/out and which room; leafWidth_ft / leafHeight_ft = leaf size; clearOpening_ft = clear width at 90 deg, derived as leaf minus ~2.25 in (1.75 in leaf + 0.5 in stop; storefront 1.5 in leaves), never a store fact; leaves = 1 or 2 (0 for an opening, null when unknown). Single leaf: pivot 'Door_<id>_Hinge' at hinge_ft, the leaf mesh 'Door_<id>' is its child. Pair: leafObjects lists 'Door_<id>_L' and 'Door_<id>_R' (L/R as seen from side A facing side B), each with its own '<object>_Hinge' pivot. The hinge pivot is the parent and rotates about its local Y only; the leaf child extends along the pivot's local +X from hinge to latch. closedRotation = pivot Euler [0, yaw, 0] in Unity degrees, yaw = plan angle of hinge->latch (0 = east, +90 = south, 180 = west, -90 = north; Unity +Y yaw turns +X toward -Z = plan south). openAngle = signed degrees added to the closed yaw for fully open (90 deg max; + = clockwise seen from above); open yaw = closed yaw + openAngle. hinge_unity_m = pivot position in metres at floor level. anchors.A/B = trigger anchors 'Anchor_Door_<id>_A' / '_B', one per side on the opening centreline, 1.5 ft off the wall line on the non-swing side and 3.5 ft on the swing side (clear of a 3 ft leaf). selfClosing = true (A310 schedules a closer), false (no closer or no leaf) or 'unknown' (existing hardware not scheduled). lock = none (no staff gate; the restroom privacy lock is occupant-only), staffOnly (normally closed and locked, staff open it, free egress from inside), keyed (key only), entryTimeLock (customer entry: locked before Open doors and from 22:00, DEC-076). hardware = lever | pushBar | storefrontPull | none (DEC-110 W6: pushBar only on the emergency exits and the delivery entrance; DEC-115 (2): every other door follows its evidence (A310 lockset), the storefront entry pair keeps its pull handles, and a leaf with no scheduled hardware is a Low lever placeholder). npcUse = who may path through in normal play: 'customer' and/or 'staff'; empty = nobody (emergency-only exits, the unplaced grille). The player is staff. The ID-checking guard (DEC-086, DEC-096) is staff for door rights, but its routine post is the entry check-in; no source puts it in the back rooms. Consumers spawn door leaves only for leaves 1 or 2; rows with leaves 0 or null (the arches, the grille) are openings or non-doors. Rows with no pos_ft (not placed: Grille_101B) are skipped by consumers until their GAP closes. defaultState = closed | proppedOpen at shift start (null for openings); proppedOpen leaves keep their closer/lock values, which apply if the prop is removed. There is no second buzzed door after the ID stand (DEC-103): customers go entry -> ID stand -> sales floor with no inner door; none is modelled. staffOnly = customers must not pass. audit (REF-013) = one record per field: {conf High|Med|Low, src [exact sources: TI sheet + door number/schedule line, A011 vector, CCTV tile, DEC], gap}; audited fields: type, position, hinge, swing, leafWidth, leafHeight, clearOpening, leaves, lock, hardware, selfClosing, npcUse, defaultState (position = pos_ft/target_opening; hinge = hinge_jamb/hinge_ft/closedRotation/openAngle; npcUse includes staffOnly). A Low field is a labelled placeholder and carries a gap id; gap = the union of the row's field gaps. When the A310 schedule column and the hardware-set headers name different sets, a field is sourced only if every candidate set gives the same value (or a DEC settles it).
